title: Touch UI
description: Disables controller mode, routes Input.touchCount / GetTouch to the legacy touch provider and gives Input's mouse and keyboard natives, and Input.GetAxis / GetAxisRaw for the "Mouse ScrollWheel" axis, to Touchscreen Mode's touchpad and keys, zooms the combat camera with the touchpad's pinch / wheel, and, in Touch pointer mode (DM_POINTER_MODE=touch), hides the game's cursor by replacing Cursor.SetCursor and Cursor.set_visible, and lets the inventory lists (combat pages, key pages, burning books, passive succession) scroll by dragging, runs the hover of a combat page in the hand that is pressed before it (so a tap selects it at once), and turns a double tap into a right click: on a speed dice it empties the dice's slot, and while a librarian's hand is shown it exits the hand, and puts a Leave button, built from the preparation menu's own Leave button, at the bottom center of the reception bookshelf, which has no back button

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: il2cpp icall resolver (0x391660) success path, before ldr x19,[sp,#0x10]: x19 = the icall name, x0 = the resolved native; the host swaps x0 for its own mouse functions when the name is one of Input's mouse natives

BattleDiceCardUI.OnPdSubmit entry (OnPointerDown branches here): x0 = the combat page in the hand; GetClickableState refuses the press while _bEntered (+0x133) is false, so a finger that lands and presses in one frame is ignored; the host runs the hover (ShowDetail) first

BattleCamManager.UpdateOtherCameras entry (LateUpdate branches to it every frame): x0 = the BattleCamManager; the touchpad's pinch / wheel notches zoom the main camera here, because the live manual camera (FixedUpdate -> UpdateManualSwitch) reads only the right stick for zoom and never the mouse wheel
ScrollRect.OnEnable entry: x0 = the list, remembered as a scroll list; inertia is switched on for dragging
ScrollRect.OnDisable entry: x0 = the list, forgotten
EventTrigger.OnInitializePotentialDrag entry: x0 = the trigger of a book, page or slot, x1 = the PointerEventData; handed to the list it sits in, which the trigger took the drag from
EventTrigger.OnBeginDrag entry: the drag the trigger took is begun on the list it sits in, and the press stops being a click
EventTrigger.OnDrag entry: the drag is carried on by the list the trigger sits in
EventTrigger.OnEndDrag entry: the list the trigger sits in ends the drag (its inertia takes over)
ScrollRect.OnDrag entry: x0 = the list, x1 = the PointerEventData; diagnostics log its drag state

UIEquipPageScrollList.OnChangeValueScrollRect entry: x0 = the key page list, whose ScrollRect (+0x28) recycles its slots and shifts the content by a row as it scrolls; its drags are applied from the pointer's last step, not from where the drag began, or each shift is undone by the next frame
ScrollRect.OnEndDrag entry: x0 = the list; a recycling list gets the velocity of the pointer's last steps, not the one its content's shifts made up
ScrollRect.OnInitializePotentialDrag entry: a touch on a recycling list stops its glide
ScrollRect.LateUpdate entry: the slot shifts of a recycling list zero the ScrollRect's velocity (SetNormalizedPosition), so its glide is carried on from the last frame's

BattleUnitCardsInHandUI.Update entry: x0 = the hand; its _isActiveState (+0x40) is the hand being shown, and Update leaves it on GetMouseButtonDown(1); a double tap while it is shown is sent as that right button

SpeedDiceUI.OnSubmit entry (OnPointerClick and OnPointerDown branch here): a click on a speed dice; a second tap on the same spot right after it is sent as the right button, which makes the dice empty its slot (EmptySpeedDiceSlot)

UIInvitationPanel.Update entry: x0 = the invitation panel; its phase (+0x98) is DropBookSelect while the bookshelf is open, which has no back button; the host builds a Leave button there from the preparation panel's back button and sends a tap on it as the bookshelf's exit (SetPhaseState(Story))
